ERGER keeps one book per share. The same share trades as five to nine tokens from different issuers, each at its own price, and most of the raw gap between them is unit multipliers. The book reads each issuer's multiplier from that issuer's own source, divides it out, and measures every row in basis points from one reference price, Chainlink on Robinhood Chain where a feed exists, with its source and age beside it. A row the book cannot read says unread and shows no number. Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain are the rows the desk can buy; xStocks, Ondo, Binance bStocks and Coinbase appear by issuer name for reference. The desk runs in your browser. It makes a one-time position account and keeps its key encrypted on your device, funds a basket from shielded ZEC through NEAR Intents, buys each leg through Uniswap with a simulation, a minimum out and a deadline, and exits through USDG to a fresh shielded address. No MERGER server holds a key or your funds. The wallet that paid stays unlinked from the position. The position account and every trade it makes are public on Robinhood Chain. The ZEC amount and time where you enter and leave the rail are public on Zcash, and anyone can read the exit payout's amount, receiving address and memo. The rail publishes its record of each leg to anyone who holds the deposit address. You post a receipt to X that shows the mix by percentage and the week. A size band, the exact day, a handle proven by a post and the position account are yours to add, and no receipt shows an address on Zcash, a transaction id, an exact amount or an exact time. $MERGER launched on Pons as a fair launch and carries no yield, no share of fees and no claim on the book or on any Stock Token. Stock Tokens are not offered to US persons and are restricted in Canada, the UK and Switzerland. That rule is yours to keep. MERGER is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected with Robinhood Markets, Inc., Electric Coin Co., the Zcash Foundation, ZODL, NEAR, or any token issuer shown in the book. Merge the market. Unlink the wallet. Post the receipt.

Coragentic is building agent-native infrastructure that enables AI agents to deploy tokens, generate revenue, and operate autonomous on-chain markets.

In today’s Web3 landscape, token launches and market operations are still heavily dependent on human execution fragmented, inefficient, and difficult to scale. Coragentic replaces this model with programmable, agent-driven systems where execution is continuous, rule-based, and autonomous.

With Coragentic, each AI agent functions as an independent economic actor. Agents can deploy tokens, manage liquidity, execute trading strategies, and capture fees all governed by enforceable policy frameworks that ensure controlled and secure operations.

This approach unlocks a new category of on-chain activity: self-operating markets that run without manual intervention. Instead of tools that require operators, Coragentic provides infrastructure for economies that operate themselves.

As AI agents become more capable and widely adopted, the demand for autonomous financial execution will grow exponentially. Corgentic positions itself at the intersection of AI and decentralized finance enabling scalable, agent-driven economies with real revenue flows.
